description: Creates an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP SnapMirror relationship that replicates a source volume to a destination data-protection (DP) volume. The source volume can be on the destination SVM, or on an SVM that the destination SVM is peered with.

Source.description: The source of the SnapMirror relationship.

Path.description: The source volume, as <svm-name>:<volume-name>. For a source on the destination SVM, use that SVM's name. For a source on a peered SVM, use the peer SVM name or its local alias, as seen from the destination SVM.
Path.markdownDescription:
The source volume, as <svm-name>:<volume-name>. For a source on the destination SVM, use that SVM's name. For a source on a peered SVM, use the peer SVM name or its local alias, as seen from the destination SVM.

Maximum Length: 512
